candidate_drafts.title: A gift that gives little
candidate_drafts.odia: ଅଧା ଭୋଜନ, ବୁଢ଼ୀଗାଈ ଦାନ, କଞ୍ଚା ଗୁଆକୁ ସଢ଼ା ପାନ
candidate_drafts.literal_meaning: Half a meal, an old cow given away, unripe areca nut with rotten betel leaf.
candidate_drafts.explanation: A gift may have the name of generosity while offering little that the recipient can use. The dictionary places this saying under a figurative expression for giving an unusable thing. The criticism concerns the quality and usefulness of what is offered, rather than its ceremony.
candidate_drafts.meaning_odia: ଦାନ କହିଦେଲେ ହେଲେ ନାହିଁ; ଯିଏ ପାଉଛି, ତାହାର କେଉଁ କାମରେ ଲାଗିବ ସେ କଥା ମଧ୍ୟ ଭାବିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ। ଅଧା ଭୋଜନ ଓ ସଢ଼ା ପାନର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ନାମକୁ ମାତ୍ର ଦେବାର ଅସାରତା ଧରାପଡ଼େ। ନିଜର ଅଦରକାରୀ ଜିନିଷ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଦେଇ ବହୁତ ଉପକାର କଲି ବୋଲି ଭାବିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ତାହା ସତରେ ଉପକାରୀ କି ନୁହେଁ ଦେଖିବା ଦରକାର।
candidate_drafts.odia_summary: ଦାନର ନାମ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ପାଇବା ଲୋକର କାମରେ ଲାଗିବା ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
candidate_drafts.english_summary: A gift should help its recipient, not merely advertise generosity.
candidate_drafts.usage_example: A club offers a broken printer to a reading room and calls it a generous donation. A member first asks whether the room can use or repair it. (Original imagined example.)
candidate_drafts.cultural_context: The old-cow image belongs to the source’s figurative wording, not a rule about the worth of aged animals or people. No ritual origin is established. The expanded areca/betel ending resembles existing143; keep this as a related witness pending semantic deduplication rather than count a new entry automatically.
